prompt: The robot waited at the edge of the forest
text: The robot waited at the edge of the forest to cast ceremonial blows. Accepting as much as we wanted, we sniveled at our homework assignment. I liked the simple and thorough introduction of academic writing, but nothing about Field Dynamics, the way people actually talked to the robot first. Facing a small hand to report the death of one
